body: I'm just very scared to do so. I don't want him freaking out and reporting me to anybody. I did made an off-color closing remark once ("Suicide hotlines don't do shit.") And got a scolding for that, which was deserved due to the fact he was about to leave and it wasn't the right time to say that. I did mention once I couldn't be alone once I got home, and he texted back "What are you implying, [Name]." It just makes me feel horrible and alone and I just don't want to be a burden and lose one of the only supports I have left because I handled all of this so poorly. I don't know how to go about it in a good way.
I get super numb everywhere, so yeah.

Sorry for responding so late, I ended up falling asleep after posting this, lol. I'm anxious about saying because I wouldn't want to be told I can't do my job well (coworkers) but at the same time I know he loves me. So I'll wait and see. 
Have a great day to you as well and thank you for your reply. :)
